source: eqlwiki.com — Skill_* pages (leveling guides, hand-curated) and item pages (recipes, vendors, drops)

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.intro: Simple path: three vendor herbs, about 1pp a combine. Manual combines until the first success teaches the recipe.

notes: All three herbs are sold by Sithgok in Innothule Swamp or Sven Felligan in Everfrost Peaks.

skills.name: Baking
skills.intro: Quick guide: bat wings and fish carry you to 135, then pies and cakes. Oven or spit for everything.

notes: Dragon Meat drops from dragons — a raid ingredient.

skills.name: Blacksmithing
skills.intro: Metal Bits and Water Flasks carry the start; Banded to 115; then the Feir`Dal kit or Fine Plate.

notes: Buy ~100 Small Piece of Ore and ~53 Water Flasks (~20pp); do ~50 Metal Bits, keep ~40 bits for later.
40 Lantern Casing Molds and 40 Bottles (~6pp); uses up the Metal Bits. Sell the lanterns back.
Gorget and Bracer are the cheapest banded pieces (1 Sheet Metal). ~50 combines to 90+.
Gauntlets then Helms are the cheapest of the 2-sheet pieces.
~7pp a combine at the Feir`Dal Forge in Kelethin — any race can use it if not KOS to Wood Elves. Cheaper than Ornate Chain.

skills.name: Brewing
skills.intro: Ale recipes are the cheap path. Qeynos and Freeport are good cities to learn in. Do not drink while brewing.

notes: One Cyclops Skull (an undead cyclops, Southern Karana) does every combine — it comes back.
Spices and Vinegar are not sold in every city.
Combine by hand until the first success; then the recipe auto-combines.
Foraged Vegetables, but cheap. Out of vegetables? Move on.
Four drinks from four Faydwer cities.

skills.name: Fletching
skills.intro: The cheapest arrows: one component sets the trivial, the other three are the cheapest going.

skills.name: Jewelcrafting
skills.intro: Metal bar + gem in a Jeweler's Kit. Unenchanted bars skill up just the same; only enchanted jewelry has stats.

steps.label: Gold + Star Ruby
notes: The price per combine nearly triples from here.

skills.name: Pottery
skills.intro: Sketch + clay + water on a Pottery Wheel; discard the unfired combines early on, they only sell fired.

notes: The skin slot takes LQ/MQ wolf skins, MQ cat pelts, LQ bear skins — or Crow's Special Brew from Qeynos.

skills.name: Tailoring
skills.intro: Silk swatches and pelts early, Wu's fighting gear to 158, Forest Green swatches to 190.

notes: Any ruined bear, wolf or cat pelt does.
Heady Kiola is brewed (trivial 46) — brew a stack first.
162 is the Coldain Prayer Shawl mark — a stopping point for many tailors.

skills.name: Tinkering
skills.intro: Gnomes only, and you start at 50. Firewater is the sub-combine behind most of it.

notes: Needs Small Fine Plate Boots — smithing.
